US Citizen Granted Bail After Nine Years of Detention in India

Matthew Van Dyke, a US citizen, has been granted bail by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) court after being detained in India for nearly nine years. He was arrested and held without conviction. While granted bail, he is required to remain in the country to face trial for alleged terror offenses. The NIA court's decision allows him to be released from detention.
